From the campaigns tool, you can create a campaign from scratch or use a campaign template to collaborate with your team and guide you along.

A campaign template provides a documented set of steps to create high-impact, repeatable marketing campaigns. You can also use these steps to keep track of campaign creation processes.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to create campaigns.

Set up your campaign

To create campaigns from a campaign template:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the upper right, click Create campaign.
  • In the right panel, click Start from template. Then, click Next.
  • From the campaign template library:
    • In the left sidebar menu, you can filter by one of the following:
      • All templates: display all campaign templates in this HubSpot account.
      • Built by HubSpot: filter by campaign templates created by HubSpot. Commonly used templates include email drip campaigns, in-person promotion campaigns, re-engagement campaigns, and more.
      • Saved templates: filter by your saved custom campaign templates.
    • Select a template that matches your campaign goals. To use a template, click Use template.
  • In the right panel, set up your campaign. You can also configure the campaign properties displayed in the form. By default, the following properties will display:

    • Campaign name: this should be a unique name that other users in your HubSpot account will easily understand.

    • Campaign color: select a campaign color to organize and prioritize your campaigns. Any tasks you associate with your campaign will feature the selected color in your marketing calendar.

    • Brand: if you have the Brands add-on, you can also select a Brand.

    • Campaign owner: assign a campaign owner to your campaign.

    • Campaign start date: set a start date for your campaign. The date will be reflected in your marketing calendar.

    • Campaign end date: set an end date for your campaign. Together with the start date, these dates will be reflected in your marketing calendar.

    • Campaign goal: use a goal to summarize the objective of your campaign. You can customize specific targets like the number of contacts or sessions after you’ve created the campaign.

    • Campaign audience: specify an audience to help your team understand who your campaign is targeting.

    • Currency code: select a currency for your campaign budget. Learn how to add and edit your account’s currencies.

    • Campaign budget: set a budget to keep track of campaign costs.

    • Campaign notes: add notes to keep track of any other essential campaign details.

  • At the bottom, click Create.

Manage campaign steps

Steps make it easy for you and your team to stay on track while working on a campaign. Add information and instructions, and associate assets to your campaign in a purposeful order.

When setting up your steps, associating an asset from the campaign details page or the asset’s editor will not automatically create a step. The step must be manually created in the campaign template editor.

To manage your campaign steps:

  • To add a new step, from the left panel, click and drag a step into the editor.
  • To rearrange the order of your steps, click and drag the step to the desired position in the editor.
  • To edit a step:
    • On the step, click the edit pencil icon.
    • In the left panel, you can edit the Step name, Step description, and Step type.
  • To associate an asset with a step, or change the associated asset:
    • In the step, click Add asset.
    • To add an existing asset, in the left panel, click the Choose [asset] dropdown menu.
    • To add a new asset:
      • Click Create [asset]. This will direct you to the asset’s dashboard.
      • Once you’ve finished creating your new asset, select the asset from the Choose [asset] dropdown menu.
  • To remove an asset from a step:
    • Click X next to the asset’s name.
    • In the dialog box, click Remove.
  • To complete a step, click the checkmark to the left of the step. Once a step is completed, the progress bar will reflect accordingly.
  • To delete a step:
    • Click the delete trash icon next to the step.
    • In the dialog box, click Delete.

Access your campaign template

Once you’ve created your campaign, you can access the campaign template on your campaign details page. To access your campaign template:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click on the name of a campaign.
  • To access your campaign template, in the top left, click Edit campaign.

Save custom campaign templates

You can use campaigns previously created from an existing campaign template to save as a new, custom campaign template. To save an existing campaign as a campaign template:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click on the name of a campaign.
  • In the top left, click Edit campaign.
  • In the campaign editor, click Save as template in the top right.
  • In the dialog box, enter a Campaign template name. Then, click Save.

Manage custom campaign templates

To review your saved templates:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the upper right, click Create campaign > Start from template.
  • In the top right, click Manage saved templates.
  • In the right panel, review and manage your saved campaign templates. On each saved campaign template:
    • To edit an existing template, click Actions, then select Edit.
    • To clone an existing template:
      • Click Actions, then select Clone.
      • In the dialog box, enter a new Campaign template name. Then, click Clone campaign template.
    • To delete an existing template:
      • Click Actions, then select Delete.
      • In the dialog box, click Delete. Deleted templates cannot be restored.

Manage your campaign assets

Not all assets will require a step. Steps present the how and why of the campaign’s creation process, whereas assets are the touchpoints your customers interact with, such as emails, forms, and more. Instead of adding a step, you can also add assets on the campaign details page.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click on the name of a campaign.
  • To manually associate an asset with a campaign, In the top left, click Actions, then select Add assets. Do note the following:
    • This will not automatically create a new step for the asset in the campaign template editor.
    • If you want to organize all assets in the campaign template editor, add a new step to the template. Then, add the asset to the step.
  • To manage all associated assets, including assets added through a step in the campaign editor or from the campaign details page, click the Assets tab.

Create campaigns using Marketing Studio

Use Marketing Studio to design your campaign, create assets, and execute your plan in a single workspace. In Marketing Studio, you’ll be able to plan your campaigns and create assets across different channels without switching tools.

When generating campaigns using AI in Marketing Studio, key details such as campaign name, goal, audience, and budget will be added. You can also add AI-suggested assets with built-in tracking directly in Marketing Studio. After creating your campaign, you can review your campaign details in a calendar, board, or asset list view.

From your Marketing Studio canvas, you can also set up campaign automations and associate your campaign to workflows. To improve how your content performs and surfaces across answer engines, learn how to optimize content and improve brand visibility for AI.

Please note: you can manage AI feature access in your AI settings and configure what data is shared. Review HubSpot’s AI Trust FAQs and AI Model Cards for detailed information on AI security controls, data use, and compliance.

Understand limitations and requirements

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to create and manage campaigns in Marketing Studio.

Permissions required Super Admin permissions are required to opt an account into a beta feature.

  • To use Marketing Studio
    • You must opt into the Marketing Studio beta. Learn how to opt your account into beta features.
    • You must turn on your Give users access to generative AI tools and features AI settings. Learn more about managing your AI settings.
  • When associating assets with a campaign, you’ll need permissions for the corresponding asset. For example, to associate a sequence with a campaign, you will need Edit permissions for sequences. Learn more about user permissions in HubSpot.

Create a new campaign

When creating a new campaign in Marketing Studio, you can generate a new campaign using AI, duplicate an existing campaign, create a campaign using a suggested template, from an uploaded document, or from scratch.

Start from a campaign clone using Marketing Studio
  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the top right, click Create and select Create campaign.
  • In the dialog box, select Clone campaign.
  • Click the dropdown menu and select an existing campaign.
  • Review and edit your cloned campaign details. Learn more about cloning a campaign in Marketing Studio.
  • At the bottom, click Next: Assets.
  • Select the checkboxes next to the assets you want to include in the new campaign. Some assets can be either associated or cloned:
    • An associated asset will link the same asset between campaigns. The asset will carry over attributed data.
    • A cloned asset will create a duplicate of the original asset. The asset won’t carry over reporting data.
  • At the bottom, click Clone campaign.
Create a campaign using a template in Marketing Studio
  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the top right, click Create and select Create campaign.
  • In the dialog box, select Start from template.
  • In the right panel, click Use template for the template that you’d like to apply.
  • At the bottom, click Create.

The template will populate empty cards and a sticky note with descriptions on the Marketing Studio canvas. You can either generate new content using AI or select existing content to fill each card.

Create a campaign from an existing document
  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the top right, click Create and select Create campaign.
  • In the dialog box, click Upload documents.
  • In the Campaign name field, enter your new campaign name.
  • In the Context field, upload the file for your campaign context. For example, you may want to upload a previous campaign brief that you’d like to duplicate for another event. You can upload files in the following formats:
    • pdf
    • doc
    • docx
    • pptx
    • txt
Create a campaign from scratch in Marketing Studio
  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the top right, click Create and select Create campaign.
  • In the dialog box, click Start from scratch.
  • Enter your campaign details.
  • At the bottom, click Create campaign. You’ll be automatically redirected to the campaign canvas to select your campaign assets and continue setting up your campaign.
Generate a campaign using AI in Marketing Studio
  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the top right, click Create and select Generate campaign with AI.
  • In the left panel, follow the prompts to set up your campaign.
    • When generating a campaign, you can preview the campaign details in the right panel.
    • The campaign will automatically generate suggested assets and automations. These will not be created in a published state. You can continue using Campaign agent to

Update your campaign brief in Marketing Studio

After creating your campaign, you can update your campaign brief within Marketing Studio. The campaign brief will also determine the context that campaign agent uses when generating content and automations for your campaign.

To manage other campaign settings such as user and team access, campaign UTMs, and more, learn how to manage your campaign settings in Marketing Studio.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the campaigns table, hover over the campaign that you’d like to update and click the verticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon and select Edit in canvas.
  • At the bottom, click the lessonIcon campaign brief icon.
  • In the dialog box, review your campaign details:
    • Context: upload additional files for context for your campaign brief. These files will be used when generating campaign assets with AI. You can select files from the files tool or upload files from your device. You can also import files from your Google Drive.
    • Goal: a description of your campaign goal. For example, consider goals based on generating leads or SQLs, improving the cost per customer, increasing website traffic, increasing overall revenue, and more.
    • Audience: a description of your ideal audience. You can also select existing segments (lists) to use as your audience.
    • Messaging: set up the brand identity, personality and tone for the campaign.
    • Additional details: include additional details for your campaign such as the campaign start and end dates, owner, and any additional notes.
  • When updating your campaign brief, any changes will be automatically saved.
    • To exit the campaign brief, click the x icon in the top right.
    • To generate new asets based on the updated campaign brief, click Generate assets.

Plan and build your campaign in Marketing Studio

Set up your campaign in the canvas view. In the canvas view, structure your campaigns and create and review assets directly in Marketing Studio.

You can also use the collaboration sidebar to add comments to the campaign or specific campaign assets and collaborate with your teammates. Learn more about adding comments with the collaboration sidebar.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.

  • In the campaigns table, hover over the campaign that you’d like to update and click the verticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon and select Edit in canvas.

  • In the top right, click + Add asset.

  • To use an existing asset, in the All assets tab, select checkboxes next to the assets that you’d like to add to the campaign. The asset will automatically appear on your canvas within a campaign card. Learn more about adding assets to your campaign.

  • To create a new asset:

    • At the top, click the New tab.

    • Select a content type such as marketing email or blog post. The asset card for that content type will appear in the canvas.

    • To add content to each of your content type cards. click + Add content. Then, select from the following:

      • Select: associate an existing asset for the selected content type. Learn more about associating assets with campaigns.
      • Create: create a new asset for the selected content type.

  • To upload existing files from your device to your campaign, you can drag and drop the file directly onto the canvas. For example, you can add a PDF or image file to your campaign.

  • To group assets together, click and drag the selection area to include the cards you’d like to group, and click the group icon.

Manage your campaign assets

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the campaigns table, hover over the campaign that you’d like to update and click the verticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon and select Edit in canvas.
  • To take action on the asset, click theverticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon on the asset card and select from the following:
    • Remix from this: use content remix directly in Marketing Studio to create new content types using the selected asset as a source. This option will only appear for assets that can be remixed.
    • Edit: edit your associated asset. You’ll be automatically directed to the content editor.
    • Clone: clone the content card and any associated assets. Alternatively, to copy and paste an asset, select the asset and tap ctrl + c or ⌘ + z. Then, tap ctrl + v or ⌘ + v.

      • If an associated asset in the content card supports cloning, a clone of the asset will be created.

      • If an asset does not support cloning, an error notification will appear.

      • If duplicating a placeholder card without an associated asset, a new placeholder card will be created.

    • Create task: create a task associated to the asset card. Learn more about campaign tasks.
    • Add annotation: add a text annotation on the asset card. For example, you may want to add a note that this particular asset should be published on a different date.
    • Copy link to card: copy a direct link to the asset card. Use this link to share the asset with another user in your HubSpot account.
    • Assign owner: assign a HubSpot user to the content
    • Delete [content type]: remove the content type from this campaign. If there are any associated assets, the assets will not be deleted and can still be accessed directly in the tool.
  • To track the connection between your assets:
    • Hover over the asset. Then, click and drag the arrow from your asset to a connection point of the asset that you’d like to connect to.
      • The connection points will automatically appear on the asset edges.
      • When moving your assets, the connection will remain.
    • To customize your line type, click the connection. Then, click the line icon and select a line style for your connection.
    • To customize your line color, click the connection. Then, click the color icon and select a color for your connection.
  • To manage multiple assets at once, click and drag the selection area to include the cards you’d like to take action on. Then, select from the following:

    • Auto-layout: automatically arrange the selected assets in neat rows. Use this option to organize your canvas.

    • Group: group and organize your assets together. Grouped assets can be moved together or deleted in bulk on the canvas.

    • Clone: duplicate all assets in the selected area.

    • Remix: generate new content based on the assets in the selected area. Placeholder and AI-generated assets cannot be remixed. If any placeholder or AI-generated assets are selected, this option will be greyed out .

Additional resources

For more resources on using Marketing Studio, refer to these articles:

  • Manage your campaign settings in Marketing Studio
  • Review your campaign performance in Marketing Studio
  • Manage campaigns in Marketing Studio
  • Create and add marketing events in Marketing Studio

Delete and restore campaigns

Delete campaigns individually or in bulk from the campaigns index page. You can also restore deleted campaigns. For example, if you’ve accidentally deleted a campaign while cleaning up old campaigns.

Please note: if you’ve opted into the Marketing Studio beta, your existing campaigns will be moved into the Overview tab in Marketing Studio.

Delete individual campaigns

To delete campaigns one at a time:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Hover over the campaign that you’d like to delete and click Action. Then, select Delete.
  • In the dialog box, click Delete campaign.

Delete multiple campaigns

To delete multiple campaigns at once:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Select the checkboxes next to the campaigns that you’d like to delete.
  • At the top, click Delete.
  • In the dialog box, click Delete.

Restore your campaigns

Any deleted campaigns can be restored within 3 months of being deleted. After, the campaign will be permanently deleted and you will not be able to restore the campaign.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • Above the table, click + Add view and select Deleted.

  • At the top, click the Deleted tab.

  • In the table, hover over the campaign that you’d like to restore, and click Restore.

  • In the dialog box, click Restore campaign.

Once the campaign is restored, the campaign will appear in your main campaigns view. Any associated assets and tracking data will be reflected in reporting.

Manually add the Deleted view

If the default Deleted view is not appearing in your campaigns index page, you can manually add it to your views.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the top right, click All views.
  • At the top, click the Default views tab.
  • In the left sidebar menu, select the Deleted checkbox.
  • In the top right, click Save.

Generate campaign insights using AI

Use the Campaign summary section to review key data, spot top-performing assets, and more. Then, use Breeze Assistant to review additional details with an in-depth summary or ask additional questions about the summary. You can also generate a summary of your campaign activity history.

Please note: you can manage AI feature access in your AI settings and configure what data is shared. Review HubSpot’s AI Trust FAQs and AI Model Cards for detailed information on AI security controls, data use, and compliance.

Review your AI-generated campaign summary

From the campaign details page, review an AI-generated campaign summary to get an overview of your campaign’s performance.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click the campaign you want to view insights for.
  • At the top, click the Performance tab, In the Campaign summary section, you can review an AI-generated summary of the campaign.
  • To regenerate your campaign summary, in the top left, click the regenerate icon.
  • To ask additional questions about the campaign, click Ask a question. In the Breeze Assistant panel, enter your question and click the send icon.
  • To copy the summary, click the clipboard icon.
  • To provide feedback about a summary or Breeze Assistant response:
    • If an answer was what you expected, click the thumbs up icon.
    • If an answer wasn’t what you expected or the thumbs down icon
  • To close the summary on your performance page, click Close.
    • Moving forward, the Campaign Summary section will remain closed for all campaigns.
    • To display the AI-generated campaign summary after closing the section, you’ll need to click Summarize again.

Summarize your campaign using Breeze Assistant

In addition to the automatically generated summary, you can also manually generate the same campaign summary using Breeze Assistant.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • Click the campaign you want to view insights for.

  • In the top right, click Actions and select summarize. In the Breeze Assistant panel, you can review an in-depth summary of the campaign.

  • Click to expand the Campaign overview or Key metrics sections for more information.

  • To copy the summary, click the clipboard icon.

  • To provide feedback about a summary or Breeze Assistant response:

    • If an answer was what you expected, click the thumbs up icon.
    • If an answer wasn’t what you expected or the thumbs down icon

  • For more information about a campaign, enter a prompt or question and click the send icon.

Generate campaigns based on AEO recommendations

From HubSpot’s AEO, generate a campaign and blog posts directly from AEO blog recommendations. You can generate a new campaign with a pre-filled brief and AI-created blog posts, or generate and associate the posts with an existing campaign in Marketing Studio.

Please note: you can manage AI feature access in your AI settings and configure what data is shared. Review HubSpot’s AI Trust FAQs and AI Model Cards for detailed information on AI security controls, data use, and compliance.

Before you get started

Permissions required Campaign permissions are required to use Marketing Studio.

Permissions required Marketing access permissions are required to use AEO.

  • To automatically generate campaigns in Marketing Studio, you must turn on your Give users access to generative AI tools and features AI settings. Learn more about managing your AI settings.
  • Currently, you can only generate campaigns based on AEO blog recommendations. You cannot generate campaigns based on other recommendations such as social posts or videos.
  • If you’ve published your blog posts externally, to complete AEO observability tracking, you’ll need to manually add the published URL to your campaign.

Generate campaigns based on AEO recommendations

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > AEO. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > AEO directly.
  • In the left panel, click Recommendations.
  • Select the checkboxes next to the blog recommendations that you’d like to base the campaign on.
  • In the top right, click Create Campaign.
    • You must select only blog recommendations.
    • If other recommendation types are selected, the Create campaign button will be greyed out.
  • In the left panel, continue working with Breeze Assistant to develop your campaign.

Generate tasks from comments

After adding comments to your HubSpot assets with the collaboration sidebar, you can use AI to generate tasks. The generated task will also appear on the tasks page on your campaigns tool and the tasks index page.

Permissions required Super Admin or Task permissions are required to create and manage tasks.

Please note: you can only generate tasks for the top comment and thread. Comments on other threads are not included when suggesting a task. Please check AI-generated tasks for potential errors.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to the asset you want to comment on.
  • From the collaboration sidebar, click the comments ccomment icon. In the right panel, both general comments and comments on specific elements will appear.
  • On the top comment, click the AI icon. AI will analyze all comments on the top comment thread and generate a task, including the following:
    • A title
    • A suggested assignee
    • A suggested due date
    • Notes with context on the task
  • In the right panel, you can review and edit your task details.
    • After confirming your task’s details, click Save to create the task.
    • To return to comments in the collaboration sidebar without creating a task, click Cancel.

Manage and review your campaigns in Marketing Studio

After creating your campaign in Marketing Studio, from your campaign Overview tab, you can export your campaign details, view and filter your campaigns, clone a campaign and its assets, or delete a campaign altogether.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to manage campaigns in Marketing Studio.

Manage and review your campaigns in Marketing Studio

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • To segment your campaigns, in your campaign table, navigate to the different views. To create a custom view, click + Add view. Learn more about creating custom views.
  • To filter your campaign by owner, click the Campaign owner dropdown menu and select a HubSpot user.
  • To filter your campaign by other campaign properties, click Advanced filters.
  • To review your campaign performance, hover over the campaign and click Analyze. Learn how to analyze individual campaign performances in Marketing Studio.
  • To compare your campaigns, click the checkboxes next to the campaigns that you’d like to compare. Then, at the top of the table, click Compare campaigns.

Clone a campaign in Marketing Studio

To clone your campaign:

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.

  • Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign that you’d like to clone. Then, click Clone.

  • In the dialog box, enter a name for your cloned campaign and set up your campaign details. Then, click Next: Assets.

  • Select the assets you want to include in the new campaign. Assets can be either associated or cloned:

    • An associated asset will link the same asset between campaigns. The asset will carry over attributed data.
    • A cloned asset will create a duplicate of the original asset. The asset won’t carry over reporting data.

  • Click Clone.

Delete a campaign in Marketing Studio

To delete your campaign:

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign that you’d like to delete. Then, click Delete.
  • In the dialog box, click Delete campaign.

Manage campaign settings in Marketing Studio

From your campaign settings in Marketing Studio, you can update your campaign properties, UTM and tracking URLs, user and team access, and canvas settings. You can also export, clone, or delete the campaign.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to create and manage campaigns in Marketing Studio.

Navigate to your campaign settings and other campaigns

After setting up your campaign, at the top of the editor, you can navigate between your campaigns, review your campaign settings, clone, and delete your campaign.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • At the top, next to the campaign name, click the downIcon dropdown icon. Then, select from the following:
    • Switch to another campaign: navigate to another campaign directly in the canvas view.
    • Rename: enter a new name for your existing campaign.
    • View details: review your campaign settings. Learn more about managing your campaign settings in Marketing Studio.
    • Clone: clone the campaign. Certain asset types will be cloned and associated to the new campaign. Assets that can be associated with multiple campaigns will not be cloned. Learn more about cloning your campaigns.
    • Manage tracking URLs: review and manage your tracking URLs. Learn more about managing your campaign UTM values in Marketing Studio.
    • Delete campaign: permanently delete a campaign. Deleted campaigns cannot be restored.

Manage your campaign properties

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settingsIcon settings icon. In the dialog box, you can customize your campaign properties or create new ones in your property settings. Learn more about managing campaign properties.
  • In the Campaign information section, you can update your property.
    • Properties values that have been populated by AI will be tagged with AI. After making your changes, When your manually-input property value manually replaces the AI-generated campaign property value, the AI tag will be removed.
    • Supported custom property types include text, number, date picker, single and multiple checkboxes, radio select, dropdown select, phone number, and rich text.

Manage your campaign UTM values

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settingsIcon settings icon.
  • In the dialog box, navigate to UTM and Tracking URLs.
  • In the UTM field, enter your UTM and press enter.
  • To review any previous campaign UTMs, click See previous campaign UTMs to expand. Learn more about managing your campaign UTM values.

Create a tracking URL for your campaign

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settingsIcon settings icon.
  • In the dialog box, navigate to UTM and Tracking URLs.
  • In the Tracking URLs section, click Create tracking URL.
  • In the right panel, set up your tracking URL, then click Create. The new tracking URL will appear in the dialog box.

Manage user and team access to your campaign

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIcon three vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settings Iconsettings icon.
  • In the dialog box, navigate to Users and teams.
  • In the Users and teams section, set your campaign access:
    • Available to everyone: allow all users in your account to access the campaign.
    • Select users and teams who can edit: allow only specified users to access the campaign.

Manage your campaign’s canvas settings

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settingsIcon settings icon.
  • In the dialog box, navigate to Canvas settings.
  • Configure the following canvas settings:
    • Allow cards to overlap: allow content cards to overlap when arranging your campaign content types.
    • Show helper lines: helper lines will appear when arranging the content cards.
    • Show mini map: a minimap will appear in the bottom right of the canvas view
    • Snap to grid: automatically align content cards to a grid.
    • Enable finite canvas: automatically move cards closer together, when placed too far away on the canvas. Turning this on will move any outlier cards to the closest card on the canvas.
  • To preview the settings on the canvas view, click Start simulation. To exist the stimulation, in the top left, click Exit simulation view.

Export, clone, or delete your campaign from your campaign settings

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • In the table, hover over an existing campaign. Click theverticalMenuIconthree vertical dots icon next to the campaign and select Edit in canvas.
  • In the top right, click the settingsIcon settings icon.
  • To export a campaign, in the dialog box, navigate to Export campaign. Then, click Export campaign.
  • To clone a campaign, in the dialog box, navigate to Clone campaign. Then, click Clone campaign. Learn more about cloning campaigns in Marketing Studio.
  • To permanently delete a campaign, in the dialog box, navigate to Delete campaign. Then, click Delete campaign. Deleted campaigns cannot be restored.

Manage campaigns

After you’ve created your campaign in HubSpot, you can manage your campaigns from the campaigns index page. You can edit and update your campaign details, clone a campaign, take actions on your campaign, and export your campaign details.

From the campaigns index page, you can also segment your campaigns or organize your campaigns with folders. Learn more about organizing your campaigns.

Please note: if you’ve opted into the Marketing Studio beta, your existing campaigns will be moved into the Manage tab in Marketing Studio.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to use the campaigns tool.

Edit campaign details

After creating a campaign, can still edit the details of the campaign. If you’re updating the campaign name, do note the following:

  • HubSpot will create and add a new utm_campaign value for all future tracking URLs associated with your campaign.
  • The old utm_campaign value will still be connected to your campaign to ensure the continuity of your historical data.

You can edit the details for an individual campaign or edit details for multiple campaigns from the campaigns table. The properties that can be edited from the table view will be determined by the campaign view used. To edit an existing campaign’s details:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • To edit an individual campaign:
    • In the table, hover over the campaign and click the menu icon, then select Edit campaign.
    • In the right panel, you can edit your campaign details.
    • After updating the campaign’s details, at the bottom of the panel, click Save.
  • To edit campaign details while in table view:

    • In the campaigns table, click the property for the campaign that you’d like to edit. Then, select or enter a property value.

    • To edit another property, click another campaign property in the table.

    • After making your edits, in the bottom left, click Save.

Manage your campaigns

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • To take further action on your workflow, hover over a campaign, then click Actions. Then, select from the following:
    • Summarize: generate a summary of campaign insights using Breeze Assistant. Learn more about generating campaign insights using AI.
    • Move to folder: move the campaign to a specific folder.
    • View performance: review your campaign performance reports. Learn more about analyzing individual campaign performance.
    • View details: review your individual campaign details.
    • Create a task: create a task for the specified campaign. Learn more about creating and assigning tasks from the campaigns tool.
    • Create tracking URL: create a tracking URL for your campaign. Learn more about creating tracking URLs.
    • Edit campaign: edit and update your campaign details.
    • Compare campaign: compare the performance for specified individual campaigns. Learn more about analyzing your campaign performance.
    • Manage access (Marketing Hub Enterprise only): assign access to the campaign. You can allow access for all users, or specific users and teams. When doing so, only users and teams granted access can edit the campaign. Learn more about limiting access to your assets in HubSpot.
    • Export: export campaign data for the individual selected campaign.
    • Delete: delete a campaign. Deleting a HubSpot campaign will not delete its associated assets and content. After deleting a campaign, you can restore the campaign within 3 months of deletion. Learn more about deleting and restoring campaigns.

Clone a campaign

You can clone an existing HubSpot campaign, including its associated assets. When cloning a campaign, please note the following:

  • Assets that can be associated with multiple campaigns will not be cloned. The existing assets will be automatically associated with the cloned campaign.

  • There is a limit of 255 characters for cloned campaign asset or content names. Asset or content names that exceed the character limit will be truncated.

To clone a campaign:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • Hover over a campaign, then click Clone.

  • In the right panel, enter any new details for the cloned campaign. You can also choose whether to clone drafted assets, sticky notes, connection lines, tasks, and tracking urls.

  • At the top, click the Assets tab.

  • In the Assets tab, select the checkboxes next to the asset types that you’d like to clone.

    • All assets for that asset type will be automatically selected as well.
    • Asset types that cannot be cloned will be greyed out.

  • To clone only specific assets, click the [asset type] to expand. Then, select the checkboxes next to the asset that you’d like to clone.

  • Click Clone.

Export overall campaign details

After creating your campaign, if you are a super admin or have export permissions, you can export your HubSpot campaign details to share information with external stakeholders. You can export this data in a csv, xls, or xlsx file from your campaigns dashboard.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • In the top right, click Actions, then select Export campaigns.

  • Configure your export file:

    • Name: enter a name for your export.
    • Format: select a format for your export, you can export your campaign details in a csv, xls, or xlsx file.
    • Send to: this will be set to your HubSpot user email by default.
    • Choose what you’d like to export: for the selected view, choose whether you would like to export the data displayed in the table or all available dashboard data.
      • Campaign dashboard data in current view: export data based on the campaign details displayed for campaigns in the current view. The campaign details in the export will correspond to the column headers in the campaigns table.
      • All available dashboard data: export all data for campaigns in the current view. This includes campaign details not displayed in the campaigns table.

  • Click Export to receive an email with a download link to the export file. This download link will be valid for 90 days. You can also review and access the campaign export from your Import and Export settings.

Manage tasks from your marketing experience home in the HubSpot mobile app

If you’re on your mobile device, you can create, manage, and edit your tasks using the HubSpot mobile app. You can prioritize your tasks to help you stay productive as you review and resolve tasks in your queue.

Please note: creating and editing tasks in the mobile app is currently supported for iOS users only.

Permissions required Super Admin or Task permissions are required to create and manage tasks.

Manage your tasks in the mobile app

To manage and edit tasks in the HubSpot mobile app:

  • Open the HubSpot app on your mobile device.

  • In the top left of the app, tap the menu icon.

  • In the left panel, confirm that your Selected Experience is set to Marketing. Then, tap out of the menu.

  • At the bottom left, tap Home.

  • To review all tasks, tap View all.

  • To sort your tasks by status, at the top, tap the All, Due today, Overdue, or Completed tabs.

  • To view additional details about a specific task, tap the task to view additional details about it.

    • You can also tap the verticalMenuIcon three vertical dot icon to edit or delete the task.
    • While editing a task, you can edit its name, status, due date, or assets with the task.

.

Create new tasks

  • Open the HubSpot app on your mobile device.
  • In the top left of the app, tap the menu icon.
  • In the left panel, confirm that your Selected Experience is set to Marketing. Then, tap out of the menu.
  • At the bottom left, tap Home.
  • To create tasks directly from your Tasks page:
    • In the tasks section, tap View all.
    • Then, in the top right, tap the + add icon.
  • To create a new task on the Marketing Home screen:
    • Tap the + add icon in the top right of the app.
    • Then, tap Task.

Manage your campaign budget

After setting up your campaign, it’s important to keep track of your campaign’s budget and spending. You can review itemized lists and amount totals for the campaign. By default, these values will be displayed in your selected campaign currency.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to use the campaigns tool.

Understand campaign budget and spend metrics

The following metrics will also be available after adding individual budget and campaign spend items. You can also keep track of the Budget total and Spend total at the top of the campaign details page.

  • Budget total: the sum of all campaign budget items.
  • Spend total: the sum of all campaign spend items.
  • Remaining budget: the remaining budget value, calculated from the Budget total minus the Spend total.

Add new campaign budget or campaign spend items

To add a new item to your campaign budget or campaign spend:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • Click on the campaign name.

  • At the top, click the Budget tab.

  • Click Create budget item or Create spend item.

  • In the right panel, configure your item details:

    • Name: enter your item name.
    • Description: enter a description for your item.
    • Unit price: enter the unit price for your item. By default, this will be set in your campaign currency.

  • After setting up your item, click Save or Save and add another.

Manage existing campaign budget or campaign spend items

To review and manage your spend items:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click on the campaign name.
  • At the top, click the Budget tab.
  • To rearrange your campaign spend or campaign budget items, in each section, click and drag the item to reorder the item.
  • To edit an item’s details, click Action, then select Edit.
  • To delete an item, click Action, then select Delete.

Sync ads budget and spend data

If you’ve associated any ad campaigns with your campaign, any budget and spend data will automatically sync with your campaign. Do note the following:

  • This sync can take up to 24 hours. If you’ve just associated an ad campaign and your ad spend and budget is not appearing, it is recommended to wait before checking again.
  • This sync will not apply if you’ve set a daily budget for your ad. The sync will only occur for ads with a Total (i.e., lifetime) budget.
  • When managing your campaign budget currency
    • If you use a different currency for your ad campaigns, your spending and budget will be automatically converted and shown using your campaign’s currency.
    • If no currency has been set for your campaign, your ad spending and budget will be converted to use your account’s default currency.

To review the synced ads spend and budget data for your campaigns:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click the name of a campaign
  • At the top, click the Budget tab.
    • Any ad campaigns with synced budget data will appear as rows in the Campaign budget and Campaign spend tables.
    • The description column for these items will be set to Ad campaign.
    • To make any changes to these synced budget items, edit the ad campaign directly. These changes will automatically sync with the campaigns tool.

Manage your campaign properties

Create custom campaign properties to store information and manage your campaigns in a way that best fits your team. You can also use campaign properties to organize, group, and report on campaign data.

Please note: you must have Edit property settings permissions to create or edit campaign properties.

Permissions required Super Admin, or Campaign and Edit property settings permissions are required to create and manage campaign properties in the campaigns tool.

Create or edit campaign properties

To create a campaign property:

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Properties.
  • Click the Select an object dropdown menu, then select Campaign properties.
  • To create a property, in the upper right, click Create property. Then, continue setting up a your property.
  • To edit an existing property, click a property’s name in the table. Learn more about editing existing properties.

Use campaign properties when creating a campaign

After creating a campaign property, you can add the property to your campaign form to collect information when users create or edit a campaign. You can also set properties as Required to ensure that all necessary information is collected.

To use a campaign property when creating a campaign:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • In the upper right, click Create campaign.

  • In the right panel, select Start from scratch. At the bottom, click Next.

  • In the top right, click Edit this form.

  • In the left panel, select the checkboxes next to the campaign properties that you’d like to add as a field in the campaign form.

  • In the right panel, reorder, set a campaign property as required, or delete the property from the campaign form:

    • To reorder the form fields, click and drag the dragHandle drag handle next to the property.
    • To set a property as required, click the Required checkbox. If the field is not completed, the user will not be able to create the campaign.
    • To remove a property from the form, click the delete delete icon.

Manage the campaign properties in your campaigns table

You can select which properties display as columns, and further filter the campaigns table using these properties. After, you can save the configured table as a view, then export the specified campaign details. Learn more about how to view and filter records.

To display a campaign property as a column in the campaigns table:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the top right, click Actions and select Edit columns.
  • In the dialog box, select the checkboxes next to the properties that you’d like to include in the table.
  • To reorder the columns in the table, click and drag the dragHandle drag handle next to the property.
  • To remove all columns displayed, click Remove all columns. All columns except for the Campaign name column will be removed.
  • To restore the default columns, click Reset default view.
  • After setting up your columns, click Save.

Manage your campaign UTM values

When creating a new campaign, a unique campaign UTM will be automatically generated. This value can be reviewed from the campaign details page and will be used when reporting on campaign data for both overall campaign analytics and individual campaign performance. Any website traffic with the campaign UTM value will be attributed to the campaign.

When updating campaign UTM values, any previous values will remain as secondary values to retain your reporting data. You can also delete any secondary Campaign UTM property values that you do not want to use anymore.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to use the campaigns tool.

Configure campaign UTM values

You can configure your campaign settings to determine if campaign UTM values should be automatically generated with a unique identifier. This applies to both campaigns created in the campaigns tool or marketing studio. By default, this setting will be turned on.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns.
  • At the top, click the UTM tab.
  • Click to toggle the Auto-generate unique identifiers for campaign UTMs switch on or off.
    • When a new campaign is created, even if it has the same campaign name as another existing campaign, the campaign UTM value will still be automatically generated with a unique identifier.
    • When using this setting, if you want to use a custom value for your Campaign UTM property, you can add a new default value.

Edit your campaign UTM value

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • In the table, click the campaign you want to update.

  • In the left panel, hover over and click the Campaign UTM field.

  • Then, enter your new campaign UTM value in-line.

  • In the bottom left, click Save.

    • If there is another existing campaign with the same Campaign UTM value, an error message will appear and the field will not be updated: There was a problem updating this UTM campaign. This Campaign UTM value already exists in [campaign name].
    • After the Campaign UTM is updated, the previous value will remain as a secondary value.

Review and delete campaign UTM values

Before deleting your campaign UTM values, please note the following:

  • When reviewing your campaign UTM values, you can only delete secondary campaign UTM values.
  • It is required for the campaign to have a default campaign UTM value.
  • After deleting a campaign value, it will be permanently removed from your account, and any traffic from this value will not be reported.

To delete a campaign UTM value:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click the campaign you want to update.
  • In the left panel, hover over the Campaign UTM field. Then, click Details.
  • In the left panel, review the campaign’s UTM values.
    • The default value will appear at the top with a Default tag. This value cannot be deleted.
    • To delete the default value, add a new Campaign UTM value. This will become the new default value. Then, you can delete the previous Campaign UTM value, which will now be a secondary value.
  • Hover over the value that you want to delete and click Delete. In the dialog box, click Delete.

Manage your campaigns tasks, approvals, and activity history in Marketing Studio

From the Manage tab in Marketing Studio, review and manage the tasks, approvals, and activity history for your campaigns.

Subscription required A Marketing Hub Enterprise subscription is required to set up and use approvals in Marketing Studio.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to review and manage campaigns in Marketing Studio.

Permissions required Super Admin or Marketing Access with Approval permission is required to approve marketing emails, blog posts, pages, or social media posts.

Review and manage tasks for your campaigns

Review existing tasks associated to your campaigns.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • At the top, click the Manage tab.
  • In the top left, click Tasks.
  • To create a new task, in the top right, click Create and select Task. Learn more about creating campaign tasks.
  • At the top, you can filter tasks by the following:
    • Status: filter by the current status of the task, such as Not started, In progress, Waiting, Completed, or Deferred.
    • Campaigns: filter by the campaigns associated with the task. For example, you can filter to display only tasks associated with specific roadshow campaigns.
    • Date range: filter by the due date of the task. For example, you can filter by all tasks due in the next month.
  • You can review your tasks in a board view or list view. To toggle between the two views, click the boardViewIconboard view icon or listViewIcon list view icon in the top right.
  • In the board view:
    • To review a task, click on the task. The task details will appear on the right.
    • To progress a task, click and drag the task to a different status.
  • In the list view:
    • At the top, click the column name to sort by the specific column.
    • To review a task, click on the task. The task details will appear on the right.
    • To complete a task, click the checkmark icon next to the task.

Review changes to your campaigns

Review the past events and activities that have occurred in different HubSpot campaigns

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • At the top, click the Manage tab.
  • In the top left, click Activity feed.
  • At the top, filter your activity feed by the following:
    • Activities type: filter by the type of activity performed, such as commenting, adding an asset, and more.
    • User: filter by the HubSpot user that performed the activity. To filter by changes made by the HubSpot system, select HubSpot.
    • Asset type: filter by the asset type of the associated campaign asset. When selecting this option, you can also filter by the specific asset, such as the specific form or social post.
    • Date range: filter by the date that the activity occurred.
  • To see more details for each activity, click to expand x updates.

Review and manage approvals for your campaigns

Review and manage approvals for assets associated with your campaigns in Marketing Studio.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Marketing > Marketing Studio.
  • At the top, click the Manage tab.
  • In the top left, click Approvals.
  • To filter your approvals by different statuses, at the top, click the All approvals, Pending approvals, Assigned, or Requested tab. You can also create your own custom views.
  • At the top, use the different filters to filter your approvals. For example, you can filter to review only approvals for marketing emails.
  • To review an approval, in the table, click on the approval name. You’ll be automatically directed to the corresponding editor with the approval.
  • To preview an approval, hover over the approval and click Preview. A preview of the approval, including approval details, will appear in the right panel.

Manually associate CRM records with campaigns

Manually associate CRM records from the object’s index page, individual CRM records, or using a workflow action. Additionally, you can also associate CRM records directly as assets in the campaigns tool or Marketing Studio. Learn more about associating assets and content with campaigns.

After creating your association, you can review manually associated records from your campaign’s performance page. If you have a Marketing Hub Enterprise subscription, you can also configure attribution for manually associated contacts and deals.

Before you get started

  • Manual association is limited to the following record types:
    • Contacts
    • Deals
    • Ticket
    • Custom objects
    • Companies (BETA)
    • Leads
  • Once a contact is marked as Influenced by a campaign, the campaign influence cannot be removed. Disassociating a contact from a campaign will not impact its influenced status. This helps to maintain a complete record of engagement.
  • If a contact has been manually associated with a campaign, only deals closed after the contact is added to the campaign will be attributed,
  • Deals that have been manually and directly associated to a campaign will always be attributed, even if already closed.
  • When creating a lead record, any campaigns influenced by the associated contact will automatically be associated with the leads as well.
  • For associations with custom objects, the custom object association must be defined before association with a campaign.

Associate records to campaigns in bulk

Associating records to campaigns in bulk from the object’s index page. When doing so, please note the following:

  • When associating records in bulk, you cannot specify association labels.
  • Bulk association is only available for contacts, companies (BETA), and leads.

To associate multiple records with your campaign:

  • Navigate to your records:
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Contacts. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Contacts directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Companies. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Companies directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Leads. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Leads directly.
  • Select the checkboxes next to the records that you’d like to associate.
  • At the top, Add to campaign. If the option does not appear, click More and select Add to campaign.
  • In the dialog box, click the Campaign dropdown menu and select a campaign.
  • Click Associate.

Associate individual records to campaigns using CRM cards

Permissions required Edit association permissions are required to create associations using the Campaigns CRM card.

Permissions required Super Admin permissions are required to create new influence types within the Campaigns CRM card.

You can associate individual contacts, deals, tickets, companies (BETA) and leads directly from CRM cards on the CRM record. When associating contacts, you can include additional details such as influence type. Learn more about managing campaign record associations with CRM cards.

  • Navigate to your record:

    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Contacts. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Contacts directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Tickets. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Tickets directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Companies. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Companies directly.
    • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Leads. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Leads directly.

  • Select the record that you’d like to associate.

  • On the right, in the Campaigns section, click + Add.

  • In the right panel, click the Marketing campaign dropdown menu and select the campaign that you’d like to associate with your contact.

  • If you’re associating a contact record to a campaign, you can also add an influence type. This option is not available when associating deals or tickets from CRM cards.

    • Click the Influence type dropdown menu and select a custom event. To create a new influence type:
      • From the dropdown menu, click Create new influence type. You can create up to 50 influence types.
      • Enter a name for your influence type.
      • At the bottom, click Save.

  • At the bottom, click Save. After adding your campaign, the campaign will appear on the campaign card. Only manually associated campaigns will appear on the campaign card.

Associate individual records to campaigns from the campaigns tool

You can associate individual contacts, deals, and tickets directly from the campaigns tool.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Click on the campaign to associate records with.
  • In the top left, click Add assets.
  • In the dialog box, in the left sidebar menu, click to expand the CRM section. Then, select Manually associated contacts, Manually associated deals, or Tickets.
  • Select the checkboxes next to the records that you’d like to associate.
  • At the bottom, click Save.

Automatically associate records with campaigns using workflows

You can automatically associate contacts, tickets, or deals with campaigns using the Add to Campaign workflow action. For example, you may want to associate a deal to a specific campaign when a webhook is received from an external application.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Automation > Workflows. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Automation > Workflows directly.
  • Click the name of an existing workflow or create a new workflow.
  • Set your enrollment triggers.
  • Click the + plus icon to add an action.
  • In the left panel, click to expand the Marketing section. Then, select Add to campaign.
  • Configure your Add contact to campaign action:
    • Object: choose whether to associate the enrolled record or a different associated record. By default, the enrolled record will be selected.
    • Campaign: select a campaign to associate the record with.
  • At the top, click Save.

Review manually associated records in campaigns

All assets can be associated with a campaign from the campaign details page. To associate an asset:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • Hover over the campaign and click Actions. Then, select View performance.
  • In the Manually associated [object] section, you can review the count and details of your manually associated records.

Manage attribution for manually associated contacts or deals

Subscription required A Marketing Hub Enterprise subscription is required to manage attribution for manually associated deals or contacts.

By default, attribution for contact or deal records are turned on by default. To manually configure this setting:

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left panel, click to expand the Tracking and Analytics section. Then, select Attribution.
  • In the Sales section, click to toggle the Manually added deals and contacts to campaigns switch on or off.

Organize campaigns using views and folders

From your campaigns index page, you can segment your campaigns with views or organize your campaigns with folders. For example, you may want to include all campaigns for a specific product within a folder, or review all campaigns for the last quarter.

From the same index page, you can also clone, edit, and take action on your campaigns. Learn more about managing your campaigns.

Please note: if you’ve opted into the Marketing Studio beta, your existing campaigns will be moved to the Overview tab in Marketing Studio.

Segment campaigns with views

To segment your campaigns, you can apply filters based on campaign details to your campaigns table. This set of filters can be saved as a view that you can access whenever you want an overview of the campaigns that meet that criteria. Learn more about creating, customizing, and managing saved views.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the Manage tab, at the top of the table, click Add view.
    • Select Create new view from the dropdown menu.
    • In the dialog box, enter a name for your view and select which users can access the saved view.
    • Click Save. Your new view will appear as another tab at the top of the table.
  • Select and apply your filters:

    • Brands: if you’ve purchased the brands add-on, you can filter by the brand the campaign is associated with.

    • Teams: filter by teams with access to the campaign.

    • Campaign owner: filter by the user assigned to the campaign.

    • Advanced filters: filter by advanced campaign details (e.g., number of [asset type], budget, start and end dates, goals). Learn more about filtering your records in HubSpot.

  • You can add additional filter options to your table with quick filters. These will appear next to the standard filters listed.
    • To add an additional quick filters, click the addIcon add icon. In the pop-up box, select a quick filter.
    • To edit the quick filters displayed, click the edit pencil icon. In the dialog box, configure your quick filters:
      • To arrange your quick filters, click and drag the drag icon next to your quick filter to place them in order.
      • To remove a quick filter from the table display, click the delete delete icon.
      • To add another quick filter, click + Add quick filter. You can add up to 5 quick filters.
      • To remove all quick filters, click Delete all quick filters.
  • After making any changes to the filters applied, click Save view in the top right, then click Save.
  • To manage your views, in the top right, click All views.
  • Hover over a view and click the More dropdown menu to:
    • Rename: rename the view.
    • Delete: permanently delete a view.
    • Manage sharing: select which users and teams have access to this view. This can be set to Private, Team, or Everyone.
    • Clone: clone a copy of the view.
    • Export: export data from the view in csv, xls, or xlsx format. You can choose to export only properties displayed in the view or all properties on records.

Organize your campaigns with folders

Organize your campaigns into folders on the campaigns dashboard. Once created, folders will display on the dashboard with your campaigns. Within a folder, you can also apply filters to further refine a search, or set a folder as your default campaign view.

Create and manage folders
  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the top right, click the Folders tab.
  • In the upper left, click Create folder.
  • In the dialog box, enter the folder name. Then, click Save.
  • To refine the campaigns displayed in your folder, at the top, select and apply different filters.
Rename or delete a folder

To edit or delete an existing folder:

  • In the top right, click the Folders tab.
  • To change a folder’s name:
    • In the left sidebar menu, click on the folder.
    • In the top left, click Actions and select Rename folder.
    • In the dialog box, enter your new folder name. Then, click Save.
  • To delete a folder:
    • In the left sidebar menu, click on the folder.
    • In the top left, click Actions and select Delete folder.
    • In the dialog box, click Delete folder.
Move campaigns to folders
  • To move individual campaigns to a folder:
    • Hover over the campaign and click Actions. Then, select Move to folder.
    • In the dialog box, select a folder.
    • At the bottom, click Move.
  • To move campaigns to a folder in bulk:
    • On the Folders tab, select the checkboxes next to the campaigns you want to move into the folder.
    • At the top of the table, click Move to folder.
    • In the dialog box, select the desired folder, then click Move.

Plan your campaigns with the marketing calendar

Use the marketing calendar to keep track of marketing events such as campaigns and tasks. You can also create and edit tasks directly from the marketing calendar.

Permissions required Super Admin or Campaign permissions are required to use the campaigns tool.

Permissions required Super Admin or Task permissions are required to create and manage tasks.

Filter your marketing calendar

Filter your calendar to display only specific marketing events.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.
  • In the upper left, click the Calendar tab.
  • To filter your calendar by different event types, at the top, click the All calendar events, My tasks, My campaigns, or Marketing email tab. You can also create your own custom views.
  • In the top left, select and apply your filters:
    • Campaign: filter your calendar events by their associated campaign.
    • Type: filter your calendar events by type of event. For example, you can filter to display blog posts or social posts only. The full list of available event types for the marketing calendar will also appear.

Use your marketing calendar

Use your marketing calendar to plan your campaign and get an overview of your campaigns and campaign assets.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Marketing > Campaigns. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Marketing > Campaigns directly.

  • In the upper left, click the Calendar tab.

  • To change your calendar view, in the top left, select Month, Week, or Day. To view a chronological list of all calendar events in a month, click List.

  • If you’ve selected the Week view, click the hide icon in the top left to hide all-day events.

  • To automatically navigate to today’s date, in the top left, click Today.

  • To navigate between different months, weeks, or days in the calendar, in the top left, click the leftright arrows.

  • To create a new task in the marketing calendar, click the Month view. Hover over a date in the calendar, then click the add plus icon. The date selected will be automatically set as the Due date for the task.

  • To view the overall details of a calendar event, click the name of the event in the Marketing calendar. You can view and update details in the pop-up box.

    • To edit the calendar event in the tool’s editor, click Edit.
    • To view more details of the calendar event directly in the tool, click Details.

Please note: the events displayed in the marketing calendar are dependent on a user’s permissions. For example, a user without any social publishing permissions would not be able to view any social posts on the calendar

Report on campaigns using the custom report builder

Create campaign reports using the custom report builder to measure the performance and success of individual or multiple campaigns. It is recommended to use campaigns as a data source to measure the campaign’s performance against other data sources such as contacts, deals, or orders.

Understand requirements and limitations

Permissions required Super Admin, or Campaign and Reports access permissions are required to report on campaigns using the custom report builder.

Custom reports use campaign-related and influenced contact data. In some instances, it is expected that the raw object and event figures may not match influenced contact metrics in the campaigns tool.

  • For campaign influence metrics, it is recommended to use the campaigns tool directly
  • When building Contact create, Deal create, or Revenue reports, it is recommended to use HubSpot’s Attribution Report Builder instead.

Create a campaign report

To start building your report:

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Reporting > Reports.

  • In the upper right, click Create report.

  • In the left panel, click Custom Report.

  • In the top right, click Next.

  • In the right panel, select Create report on your own.

  • Click the Primary Data sources dropdown menu and select Campaigns.

  • Select your secondary data sources. Learn more about selecting data sources.

  • In the top right, click Next.

  • In the left panel, use the search bar, click the Browse dropdown menu, or click the Filter fields icon and select the data source with the field you want to add.

  • Hover over the property and click Actions > View property info to review the campaign property details and description.

  • Click and drag fields from the left sidebar into the channel slots in the Configure tab, or click Actions, then select Add to X.

  • After adding your campaign properties, continue setting up your custom report.

Properties available

When building your report, you can add default or custom campaign properties. You can also use properties from events associated with a campaign’s influenced contacts.

Campaign properties

When using the custom report builder, you can use the following default campaign properties or any custom campaign properties:

  • [Campaign] - Campaign name: the name of the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign start date: the start date of the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign end date: the end date of the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign owner: the HubSpot user assigned to the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign brand (Marketing Hub Enterprise only): if you have the brands add-on, you can also report by the campaign’s associated brand.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign goals: the objective of the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign audience: the target audience of the campaign.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign status: the status of the campaign, such as Planned, In progress, Active, Paused, or Completed.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign budget total: the total budget of the campaign. Learn more about managing your campaign budget.
  • [Campaign] - Campaign spend total: the total spend of the campaign. Learn more about managing your campaign’s spend items.
Influenced contact properties

You can also use the following influenced contact event properties. Learn more about a campaign’s influenced contacts.

  • Campaign Influence - Campaign Id: the ID of the campaign that influenced the contact. You can retrieve this ID from your campaign’s URL.
    • If the campaign URL is: https://app.hubspot.com/marketing/123456/campaigns/1234-567-89101121213/assets
    • The campaign Id will be: 1234-567-89101121213.
  • Campaign Influence - Asset type: the type of asset that influenced the contact, such as a marketing email or social post.
  • Campaign Influence - Idempotency id: a unique identifier for each individual influence event. This metric is useful when aggregating events.
  • Campaign Influence - timestamp: the date and time when the contact was influenced by the campaign.

Example reports

The sections below outline common report configurations you can use to analyze your campaigns.

Total campaign budget vs spend by campaign type or name

To compare your campaign budget across different campaign types or specific campaigns, you can view your report with the following configuration:

  • Data source: Campaigns as Primary data source
  • Chart type example: Vertical bar
  • X-axis: Campaign - Campaign type or Campaign - Campaign name
  • Y-axis: Campaign - Campaign spend total and Campaign - Campaign budget total
Influenced contacts by asset type per campaign

To compare influenced contacts across different asset types per campaign, configure a report as follows:

  • Data sources: Contacts as Primary data source and Campaigns as Secondary data source.
  • Chat type example: Vertical bar
  • X-axis: Campaign - Campaign name. It’s recommended you click Edit field and sort by Descending.
  • Y-axis: Count of contacts
  • Break down by: Campaign Influence - Asset type
Influenced contacts by asset per campaign

To compare influenced contacts across different assets per campaign, configure a report as follows:

  • Data sources: Contacts as Primary data source and Campaigns as Secondary data source.
  • Chat type example: Vertical bar
  • X-axis: Campaign - Campaign name. It’s recommended you click Edit field and sort by Descending.
  • Y-axis: Count of contacts
  • Break down by: Campaign Influence - Asset name
Top count of influenced contacts across all campaigns
